metadata.case_name: LI WAN KEI v. HYUNDAI ENGINEERING & CONSTRUCTION COMPANY LIMITED

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: should be able to do work involving light to medium physical demands; fit enough to resume some kind of more sedentary jobs

injuries.description: avulsion fracture of the medial side of right humerus at the elbow; avulsion of a fragment from the medial epicondyle of right humerus remained detached;
source: avulsion fracture of the medial side of right humerus at the elbow; avulsion of a fragment from the medial epicondyle of right humerus remained detached;
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the elbow or forearm

injuries.description: tear of the posterior horn of medial meniscus of left knee;
source: tear of the posterior horn of medial meniscus of left knee;
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

injuries.description: swelling of the medial collateral ligament of left knee;
source: swelling of the medial collateral ligament of left knee;
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of medial collateral ligament of knee, excluding rupture

injuries.description: contusion injury of the right hip region.
source: contusion injury of the right hip region.

manifestations.description: significant pain in the right elbow
pain and instability on valgus stress to the elbow
residual tenderness, pain and swelling around the operative site
mild decrease in range of motion of the left knee
moderate wasting of the left thigh muscles
swelling of the medial collateral ligament of left knee
occasional residual pain in the right hip
low back pain (mild tenderness over left paraspinal muscle at the lower lumbar spine; x-ray showed degenerative changes)
occasional numbness over the left (sic) medial forearm

treatments_received: Accident and Emergency treatment at Princess Margaret Hospital (dressing applied to the right elbow and discharged same day)
left knee arthroscopy and arthroscopic repair of left knee medial meniscal tear (10 September 2003)
treatments_future: further course of rehabilitation and medical treatment for the repaired meniscus (as advised)

losses.description: should not be able to return to his pre-accident work as a construction site worker
